findings.summary: Comment and PR body implied SessionEnd stderr reaches the user; the hook reads only systemMessage/reason (cli.ts:967-969) and the #384 probe saw no SessionEnd output. Reworded to a best-effort log line; user surface filed as #473.
Mutation E (stderr skip line written on every run) survived; the can-act test now spies stderr and E goes red.
The sort-watch test is stricter than the rule: a future harmless sort over entries including an unparseable created would go red falsely. Accepted as is.
describe title says 'reported, not silent' though the report reaches only the caller and a log line.

ruledOut: stderr on exit 0 does not disturb the SessionEnd stdout JSON (cli.ts:982); runSessionEnd has one production caller (cli.ts:967); the write is inside the existing try/catch so the hook still fails open
the sort-watch test is a behavioural spy on the exported autoCurate, not a source-text guard (ADR-0070 §1); toSorted, a for-loop or an id sort make it fail loudly, not vacuously
scope is exactly #380's three items; the old V8-dependent test is kept
vilosource identity and no AI attribution
